item.title: Nvidia Mulls $250 Billion Backing for OpenAI Hub, WSJ Says
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Nvidia Corp.’s in discussions to provide a guarantee of about $250 billion to help OpenAI lease computing from a giant data center project planned for southern Ohio, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter. The deal should help the AI lab lease a 10-gigawatt data center hub that SoftBank Group Corp. is developing in Ohio, the Journal said.

item.title: Oil Drops, Bonds Rise as US-Iran Tensions Ease: Markets Wrap
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The lull in hostilities sets the tone for a pivotal week in markets, with traders focused on whether the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates on Wednesday after a recent surge in oil prices fueled inflation concerns. Investors also await earnings of tech bellwethers after a recent backlash against heavy spending on artificial intelligence.
